column1: # Four instruments: calls, calls-60d, repo-refs, and runtime-wired.
# calls: 2,511,278 command strings from 17,664 Claude transcript files (14.0 GB).
# calls-60d: the same transcript corpus restricted to files modified within 60 days.
# repo-refs: scripts/diagnostics/verb-callers.py caller counts with positive controls.
# runtime-wired: executable callers outside docs, tests, baselines, scratchpads, and diffs.
